extraction.document_summary: Great Eastern “GREAT Junior Protector” is a Singapore personal accident insurance plan for children (premiums quoted per day). The brochure highlights a daily hospital cash benefit of up to S$150 per day for hospitalisation due to an accident or for specified Infectious Diseases. It also states that the plan provides up to 3 times the payout for Accidental Death or Permanent Disablement. The Infectious Disease benefit applies from as young as 15 days after birth or 15 days after discharge from hospital, whichever is later, and the daily benefit is linked to the annual premiums of Plan A, Plan B or Plan C divided by 365 (GST included, subject to change). A key limitation stated is that Infectious Disease excludes HIV and STD-related diseases, and the policy is only for Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents (PRs).
quality_notes: The source markdown appears partially garbled/misformatted; key benefit table values for Plan A/B/C are not readable.
Only limited plan-specific details are available; the brochure references Plan A, Plan B and Plan C but does not provide the plan A/B/C daily rate or payout figures in the visible text.

policies.quick_summary: Personal accident insurance for children with (1) up to S$150/day daily hospital cash for accident or specified Infectious Diseases, and (2) up to 3 times payout for Accidental Death or Permanent Disablement; Infectious Diseases apply from 15 days after birth/discharge (whichever later). Policy is for Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents (PRs). Disease coverage excludes HIV and STD-related diseases stated in the brochure excerpt. Plans A/B/C referenced for daily-rate basis, but amounts are not visible in the provided text chunk for extraction of plan-specific numeric limits/payouts beyond the stated cap.
